findings.reason: the plan should state whether it extends the locations/executor owners or why it cannot, before a worker re-derives node resolution and remote sampling.
findings.text: §5 resolves the interactive fleet node by a new path and samples it remotely, and §2 samples two nodes, without citing `imas_codex/remote/locations.py` (whose module docstring declares it "the single source of truth for how to reach any remote service" and "the single owner of SLURM service-node discovery") or `imas_codex/remote/executor.py::run_python_script` — the repo AGENTS.md rule "never inline SSH subprocess calls — use run_python_script() / async_run_python_script() from imas_codex.remote.executor" is not acknowledged

findings.reason: without a named module boundary the author cannot show the depth is hidden behind a small interface rather than spread across many display/flag helpers.
findings.text: the design has no module/interface statement: §2 (sampling loop, cgroup CPU, per-process deltas, D-state share, stat latency), §3 attribution and role inference, §4 orphan/long-running flags, and §6 JSON-lines record plus report all land in the one existing `imas_codex/cli/host.py`, so the substantial behaviour has no interface smaller than the sum of its helpers

findings.reason: naming `executor.py` as the owner to extend turns new remote sampling into one reusable script path instead of seven-plus parallel ssh call sites.
findings.text: the plan extends `host.py`'s inline-`ssh` remote-reading path instead of extending the shared owner `imas_codex/remote/executor.py`; the census of inline-`subprocess.run(["ssh", ...])` sites the plan builds on is `host.py:364` (`_discover_login_nodes_direct`), `host.py:427` (`_discover_via_gateway._probe_node`), `host.py:527` (`_query_node`), `host.py:791` (`_kill_control_sockets`), `host.py:888` (`_ssh_to_node`), `host.py:1480` (`host_status`) and `host.py:1771` (`host_kill`), and §2/§3/§5 add more remote reads to that set

findings.reason: the section should name which existing load reader it extends and whether the duplicate is retired.
findings.text: §2 keeps a load-average figure but does not consolidate the two readers that already exist: `discovery/base/services.py::_get_host_load` (reads `/proc/loadavg` and `os.cpu_count()`) and `cli/host.py::_get_load_info` (`_format_load_row` divides `os.getloadavg()[0]` by `cpu_count`), so a third reading of the same counter is implied rather than an extension of one owner

findings.reason: with a 0 cli_options budget the section must account for the command and option it adds, by naming what it retires or why nothing can be.
findings.text: §6 adds a new subcommand `imas-codex host report` with a `--since` option (cli_options +1) and new public figure functions (public_definitions +1) while this week's supplied budgets are all 0, and the section names no CLI option or view it retires or merges — it only says it reads imas-ambix's recorder rather than adding a scraper

rubric_items.deep_module: a finding — the plan puts metric sampling, ownership attribution, flags, the JSON-lines record and the report into the existing 1788-line `imas_codex/cli/host.py` command group without naming any module boundary or interface that hides that behaviour, so the new depth is spread across §2–§6 without an owner interface.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — the plan re-implements remote node reading by extending `host.py`'s inline-`ssh` path rather than extending `imas_codex/remote/executor.py`, and keeps a second load-average reader beside `imas_codex/discovery/base/services.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: a finding — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §6 adds the `imas-codex host report` command and its `--since` option without naming what it retires or merges, or why nothing can be.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan cites `imas_codex/cli/host.py` and imas-ambix's `fsload.py`/`serve-telemetry-spine`, but proposes heavy remote sampling (§2 stat probes and 2 Hz process sampling, §3/§5 process tables) and fleet-node resolution (§5) without citing `imas_codex/remote/executor.py` (the canonical remote-run owner) or `imas_codex/remote/locations.py` (the declared single owner of SLURM service-node discovery).
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan reshapes `host kill` in place and extends the existing `host` group rather than wrapping it, and §6 explicitly declines to add a second GPU scraper, reading imas-ambix's recorder instead.
